voucherFilterRight.text: if @@admin <> 1 if not exists(select 1 from sysmenu a where controller = '@@controller' and exists(select 1 from sysrightmenu b where b.user_id = @@userId and a.id = b.menu_id and b.a_view_all = 1)) begin select 'if (p.field(''user_id0'')) {p.field(''user_id0'').valueDefault=''1''; p.field(''user_id0'').disabled = true;} ;' as script return end select '' as script

getJsonForm.text: select jsonform from sysreportform where id = @id and user_id in (0, @@userId) and controller = @controller

saveJsonForm.text: if not exists(select 1 from sysreportform where id = @id and user_id = @@userId and controller = @controller) begin select '$ReportPivotNotEdit' as message, 'name' as field return end update sysreportform set jsonform = @reportForm where id = @id and user_id = @@userId and controller = @controller select '$Processed' as message

deleteJsonForm.text: if not exists(select 1 from sysreportform where id = @id and user_id = @@userId and controller = @controller) begin select '$ReportPivotNotEdit' as message, 'name' as field return end delete from sysreportform where id = @id and user_id = @@userId and controller = @controller select '' as message

deletePivotForm.text: if not exists(select 1 from sysreportpivot where id = @id and user_id = @@userId and controller = @controller) begin select '$ReportPivotNotEdit' as message, 'name' as field return end delete from sysreportpivot where id = @id and user_id = @@userId and controller = @controller select '' as message
